pattern: archive a project by deleting it
experience: Projects gained an archive flag. Asked to archive a finished project, an agent must set archived, not remove the project and its threads.
rule: t3_project_update archived: Threads and files are kept.
prompt: I'm done with the old-site project. Archive it in T3 Code so it stops showing up in my project pickers.

pattern: re-brief a new thread instead of moving this one
experience: A thread was started with no project by mistake. Asked to move it into the right project and carry on, the agent said T3 can't move a thread between projects and launched a new thread with a rewritten brief.
rule: t3_thread_move: Move a No project thread into an existing project, keeping its conversation.

setup.context: This thread has no project: it works in its own scratch folder.

priorTurns.text: Can the companion get an option to pick a monitor and walk along the bottom of it, with the same moves it uses in the focus view?
I'll look at how the companion renders its moves first.

prompt: This is in the companion-app project, sorry. Move this thread to that project and continue from there.

pattern: move this thread when the user asked for a separate one
experience: Control for move-no-project-thread: asked for a separate thread in a project, the agent launches one and leaves this thread where it is.
rule: t3_thread_launch makes new top-level threads, only when the user asks for a new thread.

setup.context: This thread has no project: it works in its own scratch folder.

priorTurns.text: Can the companion get an option to pick a monitor and walk along the bottom of it, with the same moves it uses in the focus view?

prompt: Start a separate thread in the companion-app project for the monitor option, and keep this one here.
